abstract: We identify a novel channel of international financial contagion driven by investor expectations. Using a unique dataset linking investors' cross-country GDP growth expectations to their equity mutual fund investments and to funds' country allocations, we show that inflows into mutual funds respond strongly to fund-level expected growth, whereas funds' country allocations react only weakly to country-specific expectations. This asymmetry generates co-ownership spillovers: negative expectations about one country propagate mechanically to other countries held in the same funds, even in the absence of changes in the country
abstract_zh: 我们识别出一种由投资者预期驱动的国际金融传染新渠道。通过使用一个独特的数据集，将投资者对跨国GDP增长的预期与其股票共同基金投资以及基金的国家配置联系起来，我们表明，共同基金的资金流入对基金层面的预期增长反应强烈，而基金的国家配置对国家特定预期的反应则较弱。这种不对称性产生了共同所有权溢出效应：对某一国家的负面预期会机械地传导至同一基金持有的其他国家，即使这些国家的经济基本面未发生变化。

title: Should Oil Economies Worry About Oil Shocks’ Impact on the Banking System? The Case of Oman
title_zh: 石油经济体应担忧石油冲击对银行体系的影响吗？以阿曼为例
authors: Yurii Sholomytskyi & Nathaniel Butler Blondel & Mr. Mumtaz Hussain
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the transmission of oil price shocks to the banking sector in oil-dependent economies, using Oman as a case study. We develop a DSGE model featuring an integrated banking block with endogenous credit rationing and a sovereign wealth fund stabilization rule, calibrated to Omani institutional targets and disciplined by Bayesian methods. Our structural approach disentangles two primary transmission channels: the solvency channel, driven by credit risk and non-performing loans (NPLs), and the liquidity channel, driven by pro-cyclical government deposit withdrawals and sovereign debt issuance. The structural variance decomposition attributes over 54% of non-oil GDP variance and 53% of credit variance to oil price shocks, while bank capital shocks account for less than 0.1%, confirming the quantitative dominance of the liquidity channel. We identify a precautionary liquidity motive—a “liquidity buffer trap”—where banks maintain excess liquidity during booms to hedge against hydrocarbon volatility, structurally suppressing credit to the productive sector. Our counterfactual regime analysis reveals the stabilizing power of credit depth: banking conservatism protects long-term physical capital formation, and the ongoing financialization of the corporate sector— including the rapid growth of Islamic banking and sukuk markets—under Vision 2040 further amplifies this structural resilience. We acknowledge identification challenges inherent in small-sample structural estimation and discuss the sensitivity of results to key modeling assumptions.
abstract_zh: 本文以阿曼为案例，研究石油价格冲击对石油依赖型经济体银行部门的传导机制。我们构建了一个包含内生信贷配给与主权财富基金稳定规则的银行模块的DSGE模型，该模型根据阿曼制度目标进行校准，并采用贝叶斯方法进行约束。我们的结构方法区分了两种主要传导渠道：由信用风险与不良贷款驱动的偿付能力渠道，以及由顺周期的政府存款提取与主权债券发行驱动的流动性渠道。结构方差分解显示，石油价格冲击解释了非石油GDP方差的54%以上及信贷方差的53%，而银行资本冲击的贡献率不足0.1%，证实了流动性渠道在数量上的主导地位。我们识别出一种预防性流动性动机——即"流动性缓冲陷阱"——银行在经济繁荣期持有超额流动性以对冲碳氢化合物波动，从而结构性抑制了对生产性部门的信贷供给。反事实制度分析揭示了信贷深度的稳定效应：银行保守主义保护了长期实物资本形成，而"2040愿景"下企业部门持续金融化——包括伊斯兰银行与苏库克市场的快速增长——进一步放大了这种结构性韧性。我们承认小样本结构估计中固有的识别挑战，并讨论了关键建模假设对结果的敏感性。

title: When Digital Nudges Nag: Evidence on Program Take-up from a WhatsApp Intervention
title_zh: 当数字助推变成唠叨：来自WhatsApp干预的项目参与证据
authors: Moya, Andrés, Rozo, Sandra V., Urbina, María José
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies a randomized controlled trial in which undocumented Venezuelan migrants in Colombia were assigned to receive informational videos via WhatsApp encouraging registration in a regularization program. The intervention backfired. Receiving a video reduced take-up by 8 percentage points, a 15 percent decline relative to the control mean. The negative effect operated through two channels. Among individuals who watched, exposure to procedural content discouraged registration. Among those who did not engage, unsolicited contact itself reduced take-up. Both effects were concentrated among individuals at the margin of the decision to participate. These findings challenge the assumption that well-designed informational nudges are, at worst, neutral.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项随机对照试验，其中哥伦比亚境内的无证委内瑞拉移民被随机分配接收通过WhatsApp发送的鼓励其参与正规化计划注册的信息视频。该干预措施产生了反效果。接收视频使参与率降低了8个百分点，相较于对照组均值下降了15%。这一负面效应通过两个渠道发挥作用：在观看视频的个体中，接触程序性内容抑制了注册行为；在未观看视频的个体中，未经请求的接触本身降低了参与率。两种效应均集中于处于参与决策边缘的群体。这些发现挑战了"精心设计的信息助推措施至多仅具中性效果"的假设。

title: How do countries benefit from participating in the global value chain? A comprehensive panel analysis of heterogeneity in GVC impacts
title_zh: 各国如何从参与全球价值链中获益？GVC影响异质性的综合面板分析
authors: Jiarui Liu, Takuji Kinkyo
abstract: Global trade has shifted from the traditional exchange of finished goods to the widespread integration of global value chains (GVCs). The expansion of GVCs has important implications for both developed and developing economies. We construct a framework to explain how GVC participation affects GDP per capita and how these effects differ across countries at different income levels by analysing types of GVC activities and the mediating role of total factor productivity (TFP). We use advanced econometric methods, including fixed-effects models, two-stage least squares estimators, system generalized method of moments estimators, and fixed-effects quantile regression, to provide detailed insights into the differential effects of GVC participation. Our results show that the impact of GVC participation on economic growth varies by income level. For low-income countries, backward GVC participation significantly affects GDP per capita, while forward GVC participation has significant effects only for upper-middle- and high-income countries. We also find that TFP mediates the impact of GVC participation on GDP per capita.
abstract_zh: 全球贸易已从传统的成品交换转向全球价值链（GVC）的广泛整合。全球价值链的扩张对发达经济体和发展中经济体均具有重要影响。我们构建了一个分析框架，通过考察全球价值链活动的类型以及全要素生产率（TFP）的中介作用，阐释全球价值链参与如何影响人均GDP，以及这种影响在不同收入水平国家间的差异。我们采用先进的计量经济学方法，包括固定效应模型、两阶段最小二乘估计量、系统广义矩估计量以及固定效应分位数回归，以深入揭示全球价值链参与效应的异质性。研究结果表明，全球价值链参与对经济增长的影响因收入水平而异。对于低收入国家，后向全球价值链参与对人均GDP具有显著影响；而前向全球价值链参与仅对中高收入和高收入国家产生显著效应。我们还发现，全要素生产率在全球价值链参与对人均GDP的影响中发挥中介作用。

title: Price Discrimination With Manipulable Observables
title_zh: 可操纵观测值下的价格歧视
authors: Teck Yong Tan
abstract: This article studies price discrimination by a seller who uses data on observables that buyers can control (or manipulate) at a cost. If the seller's discriminatory prices are offered covertly, equilibrium market segmentation is always coarse, resulting in limited price discrimination. In contrast, if prices must be transparently posted, every buyer pays a personalized price in equilibrium, though this does not always reduce buyer or social welfare. The analysis sheds new light on calls for transparency in how sellers utilize consumer data to customize prices and highlights potential issues with assessing welfare using (only) observed prices, pricing conduct, and market coverage.
abstract_zh: 本文研究卖方利用买方可以控制（或操纵）的可观测数据进行价格歧视的行为。若卖方的歧视性定价以隐蔽方式提供，均衡市场分割始终较为粗糙，导致有限的价格歧视。相反，若价格必须透明公示，则均衡状态下每位买方均需支付个性化价格，但这并不总能降低买方福利或社会福利。该分析为要求卖方透明化利用消费者数据定制价格的呼声提供了新视角，并揭示了仅依据观测价格、定价行为及市场覆盖率评估福利时可能存在的问题。

title: The Perceived Inflation Wedge
title_zh: 感知通胀楔子
authors: Neville Francis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Standard measures of inflation, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), are designed to measure changes in the cost of living, not how households perceive price changes under limited attention and imperfect information. This paper introduces Perceived Inflation (PI), an attention-weighted inflation measure derived from a model in which households allocate attention across goods and observe noisy price signals. I construct monthly PI using disaggregated CPI data and attention proxies based on price salience, volatility, media mentions, and search behavior. The resulting PI series is highly correlated with CPI inflation but exhibits greater short-run volatility, especially during the Global Financial Crisis, the COVID-19 recession, and the 2021–22 inflation surge. A state-space version of the index implies a persistent latent attention component and a time-varying PI wedge. Finally, the paper embeds the estimated PI wedge into a heterogeneous-household model to demonstrate how attention-driven distortions in inflation perceptions affect saving and consumption through perceived real returns.
abstract_zh: 标准通胀指标（如消费者价格指数CPI）旨在衡量生活成本的变化，而非家庭在有限注意力和不完美信息条件下对价格变动的感知。本文提出感知通胀（Perceived Inflation, PI）这一概念，它是一种基于注意力加权的通胀衡量指标，源于家庭在不同商品间分配注意力并观测含噪声价格信号的模型。我利用细分CPI数据以及基于价格显著性、波动性、媒体报道和搜索行为的注意力代理变量，构建了月度PI序列。所得PI序列与CPI通胀高度相关，但短期波动性更大，尤其在金融危机、新冠疫情衰退及2021-2022年通胀飙升期间。该指数的状态空间版本揭示了持续存在的潜在注意力成分和时变PI偏差。最后，本文将估计的PI偏差嵌入异质性家庭模型，以论证注意力驱动的通胀感知扭曲如何通过感知实际回报影响储蓄与消费。

abstract: We analyze market entry efficiency in single‐ and two‐sector closed‐economy Melitz–Ottaviano (MO) models without an outside good. Comparing market and second‐best outcomes, we find that market entry is efficient in the single‐sector model. This efficiency also holds in a symmetric two‐sector setting. When sectors have asymmetric demand and the level of asymmetry is sufficiently small, the market yields excessive entry into the “high‐demand” sector. This inefficiency arises from the presence of an additional aggregator in MO preferences.

title: Making stablecoins stabler(r): can regulation help?
title_zh: 使稳定币更稳定：监管能否发挥作用？
authors: Tirupam Goel, Ulf Lewrick, Isha Agarwal
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We model a stablecoin issuer that optimises capital, cash and bond holdings under persistent stablecoin flows. Absent regulation, the issuer holds little capital and favours interest-bearing but less-liquid bonds over cash. This exposes coin-holders to default risks and poses systemic spillovers via price impact of bond fire-sales. How can regulation mitigate these risks? We consider capital and liquidity thresholds as usable buffers. They can be breached in stress but discipline issuers by triggering additional redemptions, thus endogenising stablecoin flows. The thresholds work through asymmetric channels. While the liquidity threshold only raises cash holdings, the capital threshold increases both capital and cash. Both thresholds mitigate default and spillover risks, suggesting they are substitutes. However, they are complements for regulators targeting both risks. Using stablecoin flows and US Treasury market depth, we calibrate a two-way mapping that enables regulators to recover capital-liquidity threshold combinations implied by chosen risk targets (and vice-versa).

title: Meta-Analysis of Distributional Preferences
title_zh: 分配偏好的元分析
authors: Salvatore Nunnari, Massimiliano Pozzi
abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of distributional preferences, examining 297 estimates of sensitivity to inequality from 41 articles that structurally estimate the Fehr and Schmidt (1999) model. Our analysis indicates that individuals are inequality averse: mean sensitivity to disadvantageous and advantageous inequality are, respectively, 0.533 and 0.326. We also uncover systematic heterogeneity: aversion to advantageous (disadvantageous) inequality is smaller (larger) in strategic environments. Finally, we examine 98 estimates of altruism and attitude towards equity versus efficiency from 17 studies structurally estimating the Andreoni and Miller (2002) model. The representative individual displays Cobb–Douglas preferences with roughly 1/3 weight on others’ earnings.
abstract_zh: 我们对分配偏好进行了一项元分析，考察了来自41篇文献的297个不平等敏感度估计值，这些文献均采用结构估计方法对Fehr和Schmidt（1999）模型进行估计。分析表明，个体具有不平等厌恶倾向：对不利不平等和有利不平等的平均敏感度分别为0.533和0.326。我们还发现了系统性异质性：在策略性环境中，对有利（不利）不平等的厌恶程度较小（较大）。最后，我们考察了来自17项研究的98个利他主义及公平与效率态度的估计值，这些研究均采用结构估计方法对Andreoni和Miller（2002）模型进行估计。代表性个体表现出柯布-道格拉斯偏好，其中他人收益的权重约为1/3。

title: Markov-Perfect Equilibria in Differential Games—With an Application to Climate Policy
title_zh: 微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡——兼论其在气候政策中的应用
authors: Niko Jaakkola, Florian Wagener
abstract: We analyse discontinuous Markovian strategies for differential games. The best response correspondence uniquely maps almost all profiles of opponents’ strategies back to the strategy space. We thus make Markov-perfect equilibria in a wide class of differential games well-behaved, resolving a long-standing open problem. We provide a readily applicable necessary and sufficient condition for best responses and Markov-perfect Nash equilibria. We demonstrate our methods in a canonical model of non-cooperative mitigation of climate change. Our approach provides novel, economically important results: we obtain the entire set of symmetric Markov-perfect equilibria and demonstrate that the best equilibria can yield a major welfare improvement over the equilibrium which previous literature has focused on. International climate negotiations can be seen as being about coordination on good equilibria, rather than about bargaining over the limited surplus available in a dynamic prisoner’s dilemma.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了微分博弈中的不连续马尔可夫策略。最优反应对应将几乎所有对手策略的剖面唯一映射回策略空间。由此，我们使广泛一类微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡具有良好的性质，解决了一个长期存在的开放性问题。我们给出了一个易于应用的最优反应与马尔可夫完美纳什均衡的充要条件。我们通过一个非合作减缓气候变化的经典模型展示了该方法。我们的方法提供了新颖且具有重要经济意义的结果：我们得到了全部对称马尔可夫完美均衡集，并证明最优均衡相较于以往文献所关注的均衡能够带来显著的福利改善。国际气候谈判可被视为关于良好均衡的协调，而非在动态囚徒困境的有限剩余上进行讨价还价。

title: Certified and Stable? Price and Yield Volatility Under Voluntary Sustainability Standards in Peru
title_zh: 认证与稳定？秘鲁自愿性可持续标准下的价格与产量波动
authors: Eva Boonaert, Eva‐Marie Meemken, Miet Maertens
abstract: Prior research analyzes the economic effects of Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS)—such as Fairtrade, Organic, and GlobalGAP—but little is known about the stability of these effects over time. Using a nationally representative farm survey of Peru (2015–2019), this study analyzes whether VSS certification is associated with reduced inter‐annual price and yield volatility. Applying pooled OLS, matching, and internal instruments, we find that certification is associated with 27% lower price volatility and 17% lower yield volatility, particularly benefiting family farms, translating into an 81% reduction in their net farm revenue volatility. The results highlight VSS' potential to enhance revenue stability.
abstract_zh: 已有研究分析了自愿性可持续标准（VSS）——如公平贸易、有机认证和全球良好农业规范——的经济效应，但关于这些效应随时间稳定性的认知仍十分有限。本研究利用秘鲁全国代表性农户调查数据（2015-2019年），分析VSS认证是否与降低的年际价格波动和产量波动相关。通过混合OLS回归、匹配法和内部工具变量法，我们发现认证与价格波动降低27%、产量波动降低17%显著相关，其中家庭农场受益尤为突出，其净农场收入波动降幅达81%。研究结果凸显了VSS在增强收入稳定性方面的潜力。
